pairs: quæ est in medio itinere contra Niniven,
which is in the middle of the journey, opposite Nineveh,
you know how you left behind your father.
And so, if it pleases you,
et lento gradu sequantur iter nostrum familiæ,
and let the family follow after us with a slower step,
Cumque hoc placuisset ut irent, dixit Raphaël ad Tobiam:
And since it pleased him to go on in this way, Raphael said to Tobias,
“Take with you from the gall of the fish,
Tulit itaque Tobias ex felle illo,
And so, Tobias took from its gall,
Anna autem sedebat secus viam quotidie in supercilio montis,
But Anna sat beside the way every day, on the top of a hill,
from where she would be able to see for a long distance.
Et dum ex eodem loco specularetur adventum ejus,
And while she was watching for his arrival from that place,
et illico agnovit venientem filium suum:
and soon she realized that her son was approaching.
And running, she reported it to her husband,
“As soon as you enter into your house,
immediately adore the Lord your God.
Statimque lini super oculos ejus ex felle isto piscis,
And immediately anoint his eyes from this gall of the fish,
scias enim quoniam mox aperientur oculi ejus,
For you should know that his eyes will soon be opened,
et videbit pater tuus lumen cæli,
and your father will see the light of heaven,
and he will rejoice at the sight of you.”
Tunc præcucurrit canis, qui simul fuerat in via:
Then the dog, which had been with them in the way,
ran ahead, and, arriving like a messenger,
he showed his joy by fawning and wagging his tail.
And rising up, his blind father began to run,
cœpit offendens pedibus currere: et data manu puero,
stumbling with his feet. And giving his hand to a servant,
he ran on to meet his son.
Et suscipiens osculatus est eum cum uxore sua,
And receiving him, he kissed him, as did his wife,
et cœperunt ambo flere præ gaudio.
and they both began to weep for joy.
And when they had adored God
Tunc sumens Tobias de felle piscis,
Then Tobias, taking from the gall of the fish,
Et sustinuit quasi dimidiam fere horam: et cœpit albugo ex oculis ejus,
And about half an hour passed, and then a white film began to come out of his eyes,
like the membrane of an egg.
Tobias pulled it away from his eyes,
and immediately he received his sight.
and all those who knew him.
et ecce ego video Tobiam filium meum.
and behold, I see my son Tobias.”
Ingressa est etiam post septem dies Sara uxor filii ejus et omnis familia sana, et pecora, et cameli, et pecunia multa uxoris; sed et illa pecunia, quam receperat a Gabelo.

And then, after seven days, Sarah, the wife of his son, and all the family arrived safely, along with the sheep, and the camels, and much money from his wife, but also with that money which he had received from Gabael.
Et narravit parentibus suis omnia beneficia Dei,
And he explained to his parents all the benefits from God,
quæ fecisset circa eum per hominem qui eum duxerat.
which he had produced all around him, by means of the man who had led him.
Veneruntque Achior et Nabath consobrini Tobiæ gaudentes ad Tobiam,
And then Ahikar and Nadab arrived, the maternal first cousins of Tobias, rejoicing for Tobias,
et congratulantes ei de omnibus bonis quæ circa illum ostenderat Deus.
and congratulating with him for all the good things that God had revealed all around him.
And for seven days they feasted,
omnes cum gaudio magno gavisi sunt.
and all were rejoicing with great joy.
